THANK U! This app actually helps me sleep. I have an autoimmune disorder that causes anxiety and chronic insomnia, so falling asleep at night is often a challenge. My mom recommended this app to help me relax, and it’s honestly been life changing!
There’s a wide range of sound options, from white noise, brown noise and rainfall to café ambience, parks, piano melodies, and even unexpected ones like a grandfather clock or dog barking. After testing out a few, I found one that works perfectly for me. Airplane Cabin! It’s incredibly calming and has become part of my nightly routine. I even use it while traveling. Silence is just too loud for me, and this sound helps create a consistent, comforting environment.
I also appreciate the built in timer feature. I set mine for around 9 hours, and love that the sound gently fades out instead of cutting off suddenly. It helps me stay asleep without being disrupted.
Beyond sleep, the sound library is super versatile. You can easily use these audio clips in creative projects, like videos or school assignments that require background sound. It’s a small detail, but really adds polish to media editing.
Even though I mostly rely on one sound, this app has had a huge impact on my quality of rest. I highly recommend it for both relaxation and productivity.
